resident_parameter_context.release_arbitration: release blocks a new beat0 but an already filling five-beat tile must finish; after that no new tile starts until compute/FIFO drain and release handshake
resident_parameter_context.scope: operator cohort registers; full-network context SRAM is not instantiated

arithmetic.intermediate: INT8 after dynamic power-of-two shift, RNE ties-to-even, saturation
arithmetic.stage2: explicit Q26 bias plus three products, saturated Q24
arithmetic.output: Q24 >= threshold comparison packed to one bit; threshold amplitude restoration is outside this milestone

conditional_ii_statement: II=10 only when the next input bank is ready, stage1 reaches at least five reserved FIFO credits, the independent result path is not under sustained backpressure, and the resident context remains unchanged.
excluded_claims: T2 dense fallback execution or a unified T10/T2 multiplier hierarchy
context SRAM or dual-bank macro implementation
DC area, STA frequency, SAIF, PTPX power, or DRAM energy
